acceptance: Run/Event/Evidence/Finding values round-trip through canonical public contracts and reuse SG-000010 identity/revision primitives rather than introducing parallel IDs.
Events are explicitly bound to a run and deterministic sequence; malformed or negative ordering fields fail validation.
Evidence distinguishes observation status and exact target revision; missing evidence cannot be represented as PASS.
Findings preserve severity/confidence/status/disposition separately and unresolved or blocking status is explicit rather than inferred.
Freshness is explicit: evidence/findings can be CURRENT, STALE, or SUPERSEDED without silently rewriting historical records.
JSON Schema and TypeScript validators remain semantically aligned for acceptance-critical constraints.
Package remains dependency-free and exact-head Ubuntu/Windows CI passes.

required: Focused protocol tests for valid round-trip plus malformed identity/revision/state/freshness/finding negative fixtures.
JSON Schema/TypeScript validator parity checks and manifest proof of zero runtime dependencies.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Extend the existing dependency-free @ineractive/protocol package with only the dependency-ordered public records required before the workspace shell.

requirements: No Evidence or Finding state may grant acceptance merely because required evidence is absent.
Provider-specific review payloads remain adapters/private records and do not leak into the public provider-neutral protocol.

outcome: The public protocol exposes dependency-free provider-neutral Run, Event, Evidence, and Finding contracts that bind exact identities/revisions, preserve provenance and freshness, and never infer acceptance from omission.
rationale: Canonical P01-S02-T02 frontier after SG-000010 identity/revision primitives.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000011 public Run/Event/Evidence/Finding exports, schemas, tests, docs, and evidence; no persistence migration or external side effect is authorized.

scope_in: Define public provider-neutral Run identity/state records bound to existing logical identity and exact revision primitives.
Define append-oriented Event records with explicit event identity, run identity, sequence, kind, source, and immutable target revision where applicable.
Define Evidence records with producer/source identity, exact target identity/revision, evidence kind, observation status, and artifact/reference provenance.
Define Finding records with category, severity, confidence, location/reference, evidence links, requirement/policy mapping, status, disposition, and stale/superseded semantics.
Provide deterministic validators/parsers, JSON Schemas, public exports, and negative fixtures for malformed references, invalid states, stale evidence, and unresolved material findings.
scope_out: No persistence, database, authorization, runtime executor, timestamp clock source, provider-specific finding type, or acceptance/PASS oracle.
Do not export the private P00 OCR-specific evidence validator as part of the public provider-neutral protocol.
title: IN-P01-S02-T02 Implement run event evidence finding schemas
